# clutch-dsh

`clutch-dsh` is a pnpm workspace and collection of plugins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
Install only
the plugins you need in your DSH Web profile.

The repository currently contains Worktree, Fireworks, Discuss, Title, and Office plugins. Each
pack
age has its own user documentation and can be built or installed independently.

## Plugins
| Plugin                                                                    | Preview
| What it does
| `@cerbur/clutch-dsh-worktree`   |                                  | Adds a Git Worktree view that
groups DSH Sessions by Workspace, Worktree, and Session. The Dashboard is a plugin-only preview. |
| `@cerbur/clutch-dsh-fireworks` |                                   | Adds the `happy_fireworks` to
ol and a short celebration overlay for meaningful milestones.                                     |
| `@cerbur/clutch-dsh-discuss`     |                                         | Adds `/discuss [topic
]`, an entry point for the bundled brainstorming workflow and reviewed design documents.

|
| `@cerbur/clutch-dsh-title`         |                                         | Adds config
urable session title templates and a settings manager for new DSH Sessions.

|
| `@cerbur/clutch-dsh-office`       |  | Lists all native workspaces vertically as
3D kitchens with up to two whale-girl Session characters. Unreleased MVP.            |
